WITH p AS (
  SELECT strategy AS book, market_ticker AS t, split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) AS game,
         CASE WHEN coalesce(lower(side),'no')='no' THEN 100-assumed_price ELSE assumed_price END AS tail,
         nullif(regexp_replace(split_part(market_ticker,'-',3),'\D','','g'),'')::int AS line,
         extract(epoch FROM (to_timestamp(substr(split_part(market_ticker,'-',2),1,11),'YYMONDDHH24MI')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') - created_at)/3600.0 AS hrs,
         quantity::numeric AS q, pnl::numeric AS pnl
  FROM paper_trades
  WHERE split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)='KXMLBSPREAD' AND status IN ('settled','closed_sl')
    AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0 AND assumed_price IS NOT NULL
    AND strategy LIKE '%mmsell%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins)),
lf AS (
  SELECT 'LIVE' AS book, fl.market_ticker AS t, split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',2) AS game,
         100-fl.price AS tail,
         nullif(regexp_replace(split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',3),'\D','','g'),'')::int AS line,
         extract(epoch FROM (to_timestamp(substr(split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',2),1,11),'YYMONDDHH24MI')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') - fl.filled_at)/3600.0 AS hrs,
         fl.quantity::numeric AS q, NULL::numeric AS pnl
  FROM fills fl JOIN live_orders lo ON lo.kalshi_order_id=fl.kalshi_order_id
  WHERE lo.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%' AND split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',1)='KXMLBSPREAD' AND fl.filled_at>='2026-07-01'),
r AS (SELECT market_ticker AS t, max(CASE WHEN resolved_value=100 THEN lower(side) WHEN resolved_value=0 THEN CASE WHEN lower(side)='yes' THEN 'no' ELSE 'yes' END END) AS res
      FROM paper_trades WHERE status='settled' AND resolved_value IS NOT NULL AND split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)='KXMLBSPREAD' GROUP BY 1),
l AS (SELECT lf.book, lf.t, lf.game, lf.tail, lf.line, lf.hrs, lf.q,
             ((CASE WHEN r.res='no' THEN 100 ELSE 0 END) - (100-lf.tail))*lf.q/100.0 AS pnl
      FROM lf JOIN r ON r.t=lf.t),
a AS (SELECT * FROM p UNION ALL SELECT * FROM l UNION ALL SELECT 'ALLPAPER', t, game, tail, line, hrs, q, pnl FROM p),
g AS (SELECT book, game, sum(pnl) gp FROM a GROUP BY 1,2),
gs AS (SELECT book, count(*) games, avg(gp) mg, stddev_samp(gp)/sqrt(count(*)) seg FROM g GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.book, count(*) trades, count(DISTINCT a.t) mkts, gs.games,
       round(100*sum(pnl)/sum(q),2) c_per_ct, round(sum(pnl),2) net,
       round(gs.mg::numeric,3) mean_g, round(gs.seg::numeric,3) se_g, round((gs.mg/nullif(gs.seg,0))::numeric,2) z,
       round(avg(tail),1) tail, round(100.0*avg((line<=2)::int),0) pct_l12, round(100.0*avg((line between 3 and 4)::int),0) pct_l34,
       round(100.0*avg((line>=5)::int),0) pct_l5p,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY hrs))::numeric,1) med_hrs_pre,
       round(100.0*avg((hrs<0)::int),0) pct_ingame
FROM a JOIN gs ON gs.book=a.book GROUP BY a.book, gs.games, gs.mg, gs.seg
HAVING count(*)>=100 OR a.book IN ('LIVE','ALLPAPER') ORDER BY c_per_ct DESC
